title: Psalms 150
paragraphs: ¹ Praise the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens. ² Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness. ³ Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet; praise him with the harp and lyre. ⁴ Praise him with timbrel and dancing; praise him with the strings and pipe. ⁵ Praise him with the clash of cymbals; praise him with resounding cymbals.
⁶ Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.
